scope: Read-only independent raw benchmark score reconstruction; no model, environment, GPU, network, solver edit or submission.
score_formula: For each completed level i (1-based), min(115,100*(baseline_actions/actual_actions)^2), weighted by i; divide by total possible level weights, capped at100 times sum of positive-scoring completed weights/total possible weights. Average all25 games unweighted.
limits: One sequential shared-service experiment has no paired random seeds or independent replications. No causal or statistical-significance claim.
Score reconstruction does not prove identical mode, budget compliance, template verification or cleanup; root separate integrity audit remains necessary.
Cancelled states in a time-limited completed benchmark are not by themselves crashes.
Public fullpool score is not official competition submission score. Formal best31.16 remains unchanged without a new official result.
